description: This file defines a sealed class ApiResult representing the result of an API call, supporting success and error cases. It also includes extension functions to check if the result is a success or error.

classes.name: ApiResult
classes.description: A sealed class representing either a successful or an error result from an API call.

classes.name: ApiResult.Success
classes.description: Represents a successful API response with data and optional message.

classes.name: ApiResult.Error
classes.description: Represents an error response with a message and optional error code.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Extension function to determine if an ApiResult instance indicates success.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Extension function to determine if an ApiResult instance indicates an error.
